gloss: method of personnel selection; way of deploying people

definitions.gloss: method of personnel selection; way of assigning or deploying people
definitions.explanation: The approach or strategy used when selecting people for roles, positions, or tasks. Used in management, sports (player selection), and organizational contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起用法|きようほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疑問|ぎもん}→疑問：02648_gimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Questions were raised about the manager's player selection approach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起用法|きようほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
Composed of ⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧ (appointment/selection for a role) and ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (method/way). Frequently appears in sports journalism when discussing a coach or manager's decisions about player lineups and deployment strategies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起用法|きようほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change the deployment approach
- {起用法|きようほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to review personnel selection methods
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧な{起用法|きようほう}: bold personnel selection

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧: appointment/selection — the base word
- ⟦{人事|じんじ}→人事：00126_jinji⟧: personnel affairs/HR — broader organizational term
- ⟦{配置|はいち}→配置：14409_haichi⟧: placement/assignment — focuses on where people are positioned
- ⟦{抜擢|ばってき}→抜擢：07946_batteki⟧: promotion of talent — selecting someone for unexpected advancement
